title: Establish stability gates and slow-roll pinflow for vector rerankers
creator: Ravi Patel
description: Add a slow-roll, gate-driven pinning workflow for new embedding+reranker model variants that layers automated stability checks (latency/throughput/accuracy regressions) and a staged rollout orchestrator so we can safely promote artifacts from candidate -> staging -> stable across CPU/GPU and quantized variants.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible slow-roll policy is available in the pin orchestrator that can declare candidate, staging, and stable states for a model artifact
Stability gates evaluate latency (p95), token throughput, and a small held-out nDCG/recall prompt set automatically on artifact publication
Rollout automation can execute incremental traffic shifts (0% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback if any gate fails
Canary runs and gate results are persisted and visible in the console release dashboard
Cross-architecture fallback mapping is defined so requests degrade to compatible variants when pin state or capacity prevents serving the primary variant
implementation_steps: Design gate metrics and thresholds with ML and SRE (latency p50/p95, throughput tokens/s, embedding cosine drift and reranker nDCG delta)
Extend profile publisher to emit a short validation manifest that the pin orchestrator can consume
Implement slow-roll orchestration: traffic scheduling, gating hooks, and rollback triggers
Add a lightweight canary harness that runs synthetic workloads against staging variants and reports to telemetry
Integrate gate results with Console so PMs/Owners can approve or abort promotions
Create a compatibility mapping for cross-arch fallbacks (e.g., float32 GPU -> int8 CPU-safe variant) and add to manifest
